SpecialPageCaptchaTTL.description: The time to live (TTL) in seconds for the session secret key set by the extension, which allows the user to bypass the CAPTCHA. The default is 1800 (seconds), i.e. 60 seconds * 30 minutes.

SpecialPageCaptchaWhitelist.description: A whitelist of special pages which will never show the CAPTCHA. Special:Captcha is provided by the ConfirmEdit extension and it's the help page about CAPTCHAs, whereas the log in/log out pages are provided by MW core and their inclusion here oughta be self-explanatory.

SpecialPageCaptchaLanguageWhitelist.description: One or more language codes such as en or de-DE. Users whose browsers are set to one of these languages will not see a CAPTCHA. Most bots request en, en-US, or no language at all, so if your wiki is in a language other than English and the majority of your users use a non-English browser setting, those users won't have to go through a CAPTCHA but the bots still will.
